# Your Daily Briefing — Wednesday 19 August

Yesterday was a solid day. You covered 10km in 53 minutes at 156bpm average — a decent aerobic effort — and your total burn of 3,178 kcal with 14,679 steps shows you were genuinely active. Good work putting the kilometres in.

Recovery looks encouraging. HRV at 111ms sits comfortably within your 100–118ms baseline, and a resting HR of 46bpm with stress at just 30/100 suggests your body handled yesterday well. You're good to go as planned today — no need to dial back.

The one thing to flag honestly is sleep — 5.7 hours isn't enough, especially on training days. Tonight, prioritise getting to bed earlier. Also, with a 875 kcal deficit yesterday, make sure you're hitting those 175g protein and not under-fuelling — that gap will catch up with you if repeated. You're on a good trajectory, keep it going! 💪
